summary.en: Amps, delay, studio improvisation: sound becomes space.
summary.zh: 扩音、延时与工作室即兴：声音成为空间。

body.en: Psychedelic rock treats the studio as an instrument. Effects, tape collage, and longer forms open doors to Progressive Rock and experimental rock.
body.zh: 迷幻摇滚把录音室当作乐器。效果器、磁带拼贴与更长的曲式结构，打开了 Progressive Rock 与实验摇滚的大门。
